title: Convert Components
summary: Opens ConvRulesEditor on the components selected in the form designer
intro: Read this when you want to convert components from the form designer. Select them, choose drag-lint > Convert Components > Convert Selected Component(s)...; drag-lint saves and closes the unit and opens ConvRulesEditor on its Convert tab with the matching books checked. You press Convert. The unit reopens when the editor closes.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Convert Components > Convert Selected Component(s)...
steps: Open the form in the designer and select the component(s)
Choose drag-lint > Convert Components > Convert Selected Component(s)...
Save the unit if asked; it closes and ConvRulesEditor opens on its Convert tab
Check the scope and the books, press Convert, close the editor; the unit reopens

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Convert Components > Convert All of This Type on the Form...
steps: Open the form in the designer and select a component of each type to convert
Choose drag-lint > Convert Components > Convert All of This Type on the Form...
Save the unit if asked; it closes and ConvRulesEditor opens on its Convert tab with every instance of those types in scope
Press Convert, close the editor; the unit reopens

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Convert Components > Open Conversion Editor...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Convert Components > Open Conversion Editor...
ConvRulesEditor opens with the unit loaded and no scope; the unit stays open

questions.ask: How do I convert the components I selected on a form?
questions.command: drag-lint > Convert Components > Convert Selected Component(s)...
